newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus grants offshore licences to two banks.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus grants offshore licences to two banks.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus has granted licences to subdidiaries of Republic National Bank of New York and Safra Republic Holdings SA of Luxembourg to operate on the island on an offshore basis.

In a statement, the Central Bank said the two units will operate as administered banking units after entering into a management agreement with the Bank of Cyprus, the island's largest commercial bank.
Under terms of the agreement the Bank of Cyprus will carry out the day-to-day operations and administration of the two banks.

The Republic National Bank of New York (Cyprus) Ltd and Safra Republic (Cyprus) Ltd will deal only in foreign currencies and transact business only with other offshore and non-resident companies as well as non-resident persons.

They will be subject to the supervision and inspection of the Central Bank in addition to the supervison of the United States and Luxembourg banking supervisory authorities respectively, the central bank said.

"The Republic National Bank of New York is the first American bank to establish an offshore presence in Cyprus. The presence of the Republic National Bank of New York (Cyprus) Ltd and Safra Republic (Cyprus) Ltd in Cyprus is another indication of our country's success in attracting prime international banks and financial institutions and of Cyprus's growing recognition among such institutions as a reputable offshore financial centre," the central bank said.

There are currently 28 offshore banking units, three administered banking uinits and eight representative offices which have been licenced by the central bank to operate from Cyprus on an offshore basis.
The central bank said other foreign banks have expressed a similar interest in establishing an offshore presence in Cyprus and more banking business licences are expected to be granted in future.
